params.prompt:
Edit only the grounded leg in IMAGE1. Keep the head, upper body, hands, clothes and camera size completely unchanged. One transparent sprite. IMAGE2 only shoe direction, IMAGE3 style.
The image already has correct RIGHT leg support: it is the planted boot on SCREEN RIGHT. Keep that exact support-leg identity. The other boot on SCREEN LEFT is lifted and must stay lifted.
Make the RIGHT planted leg extend slightly backward toward LOWER-LEFT along the run direction, so the boot lands about HALF A BOOT WIDTH to the left of its current planted position. Keep the RIGHT full sole flat and bearing weight, with low heel. Redraw right knee and shin as one connected anatomical chain, keep a visible strip of the right shin connecting to the support boot. Do not cross the thigh in front of the left thigh. The boot should still remain to the RIGHT of the lifted left boot, not stacked below it. Do not over-extend or shorten the whole character.
Keep LEFT lifted knee/boot at same location. No switching support side, no third leg, no disconnected foot. Both boot axes point upper-right in perspective, no outward splay. Keep native square layout and transparency; no floor, shadows, labels or effects.
